title: Pond's Hydra Miracle
text: A CGI spec ad that sells hydration without a single word on screen. Not affiliated with Unilever
idea: The whole frame stays in the bottle's pale blue, water tells the story, lab glassware signals science, and a corridor of bottles narrows down to one. No voiceover and no on-screen copy.
why: One colour from start to finish, so the product never fights for attention.
Water does the talking before anyone reads the label.
Repetition, then focus: many bottles, then one.
